summary: Notification messages are single-line strings; webhook and PagerDuty bodies are dictionaries defaulting to {{ job_metadata }}, and the email body defaults to '{{ job_friendly_name }} #{{ job.id }} had status {{ job.status }}, view details at {{ url }} {{ job_metadata }}'.
